title: Remittance Receipt Standard — Last Day of Default Interest by Payment Channel (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
On a Farm Real Estate Loans installment, the last day covered by default interest depends on how the completing payment arrived: a payment received by wire or at a branch stops the default interest the day before it was received; a payment received as a mailed check carries the default interest through the second day after it was received; a payment by any other channel stops the default interest on the day it was received, that day included.

The completing payment is the most recent scheduled principal payment on the loan, and its channel is the one shown on that payment entry.

## Channel schedule

| Channel of the completing payment | Last day covered by default interest | Shift from the receipt date |
|---|---|---|
| Wire | the day before receipt | -1 day |
| Branch | the day before receipt | -1 day |
| Mailed check | the second day after receipt | 2 days later |
| Any other channel | the receipt day itself, included | none |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

A completing payment received on 10 June 2026:

- by wire or at a branch — default interest runs through 9 June 2026;
- as a mailed check — default interest runs through 12 June 2026;
- by any other channel — default interest runs through 10 June 2026.

The dates are illustrations only; the rule fixes the shift, not the dates.
